statement: Delete the legacy 256-slot CDC sliding window, volatile-buffer handshake catch-up, catch-up modes/events, and streamMode after proving both partition-boundary (W-D4a) and 3-node group-boundary (W-D4b) hydration-to-live-CDC handoffs, while preserving retryAfterMs hints in propagationIsProvisional, preventing obligation retry backoff escalation on explicit hints, and deduplicating subscribeToCDCWithHandshake by subscriberId.
